self.reason: Provides the app its own identity (app_id) and access to its tarball entries and PNG metadata chunks.

conversations.reason: Reserved for persisting conversation history and message trees; not yet wired in server.lua.

kv.reason: Stores and retrieves per-session chat message history (dom.lua) and connection/generation/prompt presets (presets.lua).

time.reason: Provides a wall-clock timestamp source available to all entries; used by the platform runtime for session bookkeeping.

server.reason: Accepts HTTP requests and routes POST /chat, POST /chat-stream, and GET /count-tokens to the card's LLM methods.

llm.reason: Invokes llm.call and llm.call_stream to send assembled message sequences to the language model and stream back the assistant's reply.

server.reason: Accepts HTTP requests and routes POST /api/import/png and POST /api/import/json to the CCv2 card parser.
